title: Boundary mass bounds the directional-derivative pairings of the density of a top-dimensional current
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ, n := d + 1, U ⊆ ℝⁿ = Euclid (d + 1) an arbitrary set, Y ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)) and u : ℝⁿ → ℝ with Y(ω) = ∫_U u(y)·ω(y)(e) dy for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U (d + 1)), where e = (e_0, …, e_d), e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1. Assume M_U(∂Y) = Y.boundary.massOn U ≠ ∞. Let ε ∈ Covector (Euclid (d + 1)) d, f : ℝⁿ → ℝ, z ∈ ℝⁿ and M ∈ ℝ satisfy: |ε| ≤ ‖z‖ (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm); d(f·ε)(y)(e) = Df(y)(z) for every y ∈ ℝⁿ (exteriorDerivative (fun x => f x • ε) y e = fderiv ℝ f y z); f is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), has compact support and tsupport f ⊆ U; and |f(y)| ≤ M for every y. Then |∫_U u(y)·Df(y)(z) dy| ≤ (M_U(∂Y)).toReal·‖z‖·M.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid (d + 1))) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)) (u : Euclid (d + 1) → ℝ) (ε : Covector (Euclid (d + 1)) d) (f : Euclid (d + 1) → ℝ) (z : Euclid (d + 1)) (M : ℝ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (d + 1), Y ω = ∫ y in U, u y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (d + 1)) (d + 1)) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → Y.boundary.massOn U ≠ ∞ → covectorEuclideanNorm ε ≤ ‖z‖ → (∀ y, exteriorDerivative (fun x => f x • ε) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ f y z) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → (∀ y, |f y| ≤ M) → |∫ y in U, u y * fderiv ℝ f y z| ≤ (Y.boundary.massOn U).toReal * ‖z‖ * M
